title: Kenui's Default
description: An enhanced look from default Minecraft!
body:
# Kenui's Default
**A resource pack that reimagines Minecraft's style while maintaining the classic feel of the vanilla game!**
-------------------------
## Featuring:
- Variated Bookshelves!
- Improved general GUI and HUD!
- New block textures!
- Emissive Ores/Blocks!
- Enchanted Book custom textures!
- Stylized Font!
- New pack picture!
- Higher Wheat Crops!
- Reworked netherite textures!

### Recommended using OptiFine or EMF/ETF and CIT support mods!
 Recommended **Polytone** mod for better lighting!
 More elements will be added soon!
